use_cases: Background decoration for landing pages and contact sections
Interactive visual element for creative portfolios
Dynamic canvas art for entertainment and media sites
Engaging background for any web application needing visual interest
ai_summary: An interactive canvas-based animation component that renders smooth, flowing wavy lines with mouse and click interactivity. The canvas responds to hover by influencing wave patterns and creates expanding energy fields from click interactions. Designed as a decorative background element for contact sections and landing pages, featuring customizable colors and animation speed. Uses a minimalist visual style with simple line rendering on a solid background color.
